verdict: Execution and 10 ms reproduction passed. Delay ranking is integration-step sensitive; convergence of the selected closed-loop case is not established.
scope: One frozen checkpoint, one selected episode, three delays and three steps; not nine independent episodes.
cost_reconstruction_limit: Tracking RMSE is taken from metrics; it cannot be independently recovered from spatial mean/max temperature series alone. Terminal cost and command effort/slew/fallback integrals are checked against saved states/events.
mechanism_limit: First command changes occur with equal admission masks and no filter intervention. This identifies score-ordering changes but does not isolate integrator error, BF16 effects, or policy discontinuity as the sole cause.
